Hi Anita / Helio team,

Thanks for moving this forward — excited to get Helio onboarded. To accelerate contracting, attaching our baseline MSA + Order Form (stubs) and a short intake checklist. Can you confirm the items below so legal and ops can start the first pass?

Quick asks (can reply inline):
- Canonical counterparty name and full legal address for the contract (exact line-by-line).
- Billing contact (name, email, phone) + invoice remit address.
- Signatory for Master Services Agreement and who will sign the Order Form (name, title, email).
- Data residency requirement: will Helio require EU-only residency for customer data or are multi-region (US primary) acceptable? Any contractual residency carveouts we should expect.
- Any mandatory exhibits you require (e.g., Exhibit D residency, Exhibit E hosting or third-party subprocessors).
- Security evidence: do you have a SOC 2 report or recent pen test report you can share?
- Target start date for services and initial seat/unit counts for Order Form.

Internal notes: Kimberly / Marissa / Jonas — please triage once external replies arrive. Kimberly: first-pass redline request (72h turnaround if no unusual residency/jurisdiction asks). Marissa: I'll hand billing/contact updates to you. Jonas: can you own the signer matrix once we have names?

Attachments: redwood_draft_MSA_v1.docx (stub), redwood_draft_OrderForm_v1.xlsx (stub)

Proposed next step: quick 30-min sync if Helio has open questions; otherwise we'll do an initial legal redline and route.

Thanks,

Thanks Anita and Sergio — good starter info. Legal will take the first-pass redline on the Helio_MSA_Redline.docx and align to our template. A few immediate asks from legal/risk so we scope the review: 

- Residency: because Helio flagged EU-only for certain customers, we need the list of EU-customer flags or a sample set of use cases. If Helio expects EU-only for a broad class, we may need to propose a standard Exhibit D and an operational runbook. If it's per-customer, we can handle with per-Order-Form flags.

- Exhibits: confirmed — we'll draft Exhibit D (Residency) and review your subprocessors request for Exhibit G. Please provide any subprocessors list you require.

- Security evidence: please upload SOC 2 Type II (PDF) and latest pen test summary. Security will need the actual reports to confirm standard carveouts. We can redact where necessary for the initial review.

- Timing: assuming no novel carveouts or high-risk items, legal's estimated turnaround for an initial redline is ~72 hours from receipt of the SOC2 and final party names. If there are residency carveouts that require product/infra changes, that will extend the timeline.

Action owners:
- Sergio: confirm the Thu 9/16 sync and add hubspot deal link + deal_id.
- Marissa: please prepare invoice remit template and vendor onboarding fields once Priya confirms.
- Jonas: once we have signer names I want the signer matrix (who signs MSA vs Order Form + fallback signers).

I'll pick this up and circulate redline + a short cover note with blocking issues.
